Section: Build identity and intended route
## Build identity and intended route Build B017 was completed on 2025-02-03 for study SYN-IN718-FAT-01. Eight fatigue coupons, B017-F01 through B017-F08, and three process witnesses were assigned build-prefixed identifiers. The gauges were designed as nominal 4.0 mm diameter by 12 mm length. Grips may be machined; the load-bearing gauge remains as-built through the subsequent recorded treatment route. The controlled nominal recipe was [PROC-LPBF-001](PROC-LPBF-001.md). Parameters below are programmed values, not measured local melt-pool conditions. This distinction is important when interpreting process stability or a later lack-of-fusion concern.

Section: Process history and deviations
## Process history and deviations At layer 842, a recoater torque alert paused exposure for 74 seconds. At layer 845, a scan-controller restart interrupted the job for 91 seconds. The operator resumed both events, but the supervisor restart fields were blank. These durations exceeded the procedure's 30-second review trigger. Successful completion of the build does not supply the missing authorization. An east-sector witness near zones E3/E4 showed a discontinuous contour trace at the gauge-height band. The relevant layers lie around 33.7–33.8 mm above the platen, within the nominal 30–42 mm gauge-height interval. Registration to a particular fracture origin has not been demonstrated. No reliable measurement of actual local laser energy is available. The operator recorded a dark streak at the powder-bed edge following the restart. The previous machine campaign used Ti-6Al-4V, and the material-change cleaning signoff was incomplete. These facts justify checking for cross-material contamination, but visual appearance cannot establish alloy identity or contamination concentration.

Section: Preliminary witness inspection
## Preliminary witness inspection | Witness | Relative density (%) | Sa (µm) | |---|---:|---:| | B017-W1 | 99.88 | 15.1 | | B017-W2 | 99.91 | 14.6 | | B017-W3 | 99.89 | 15.4 | The three density witnesses pass the bulk screening limit, but this does not close the contour-continuity concern. As-built Sa measurements overlap the reference build's range and cannot by themselves establish a cause of any later fatigue deficit. No build-wide XCT census is included. The build was held for engineering review, with coupons permitted to proceed only for the pilot investigation. The incomplete cleaning signoff and missing restart authorization remain process-record deficiencies. They must not be rewritten after later results become available.

Section: Handoff and interpretation limits
## Handoff and interpretation limits Transfer all eight identified coupons to [HT-B017](HT-B017.md), retaining gauge surfaces and this build history. Fatigue testing is reported separately in [FAT-B017](FAT-B017.md). The density readings and surface observations above are the complete preliminary measurement extract supplied here; underlying image files are not included. This record intentionally contains observations, not a final root-cause determination. It was issued before the fatigue campaign and must not be read as though the later fracture evidence already existed. Surface-connected defects, powder effects and other explanations remain candidates at this stage.
